facts.business: Enviro Infra Engineers Limited is a technology-driven company operating in water, wastewater, and renewable energy infrastructure, delivering EPC solutions for STPs, CETPs, tertiary treatment, and ZLD, while also developing renewable energy IPP assets (solar, BESS) through a subsidiary.

segments.name: Renewable Energy (IPP & EPC via EIE Renewables Pvt Ltd)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Targeting a 75:25 mix of EPC and Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM) projects
IPP segment evaluated on long-term IRR, sustained energy sales revenue, and lease rental income

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matters: (1) Revenue recognition for long-term contracts; (2) Litigation matters & contingent liabilities (Note 42)

key_risks: Forward-looking statements subject to assumptions and uncertainties
Complex litigation and contingent liabilities (legal, tax, regulatory, corporate guarantees, funding commitments)
Revenue recognition dependent on management estimates for long-term projects
Execution risk in large-scale EPC and IPP projects
Regulatory changes in water and energy sectors
facts.related_party_note: Material RPT threshold at 10% of consolidated turnover (INR 114.56 Cr based on FY26 turnover of INR 1,145.60 Cr). Transactions with EIEL AIEPL JV approved by Audit Committee at arm's length. Promoters (Sanjay Jain, Manish Jain) and relatives deemed interested. No related party may vote on RPT resolutions.
